fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 is worth only one finite falsification test. Unrestricted global cubic variables may act as pseudo-product slack and absorb the parity repair, while fixed degree-three consistency can still admit exact signed pseudo-evaluations under overlap; even a finite pass supplies no composition, padding, or n^c gap law.

Kill Proposal 2. Completeness forces the code coset to contain all required honest encodings and its kernel to contain their differences, so expander distance cannot exclude any cheat in that forced span; no explicit compatible code family or unrestricted fixed-target distance analysis is supplied.

Kill Proposal 3. No concrete integral chain complex, lift, boundary maps, or fixed-target embedding is defined, and mod-2 cosystolic expansion would not certify the required integer lattice statement; arbitrary clause incidence can retain bounded local boundaries.

Kill Proposal 4. If distinct legal lattice points u and v are at target distance R, then 2u-v is another lattice point at distance at most 3R; choosing an extremal pair ensures such a point lies outside the finite legal set. Thus the proposed shell alone has a constant second-shell ratio and cannot yield n^c.

Kill Proposal 5. It assumes an unverified kernel-free seed and an unspecified product lemma, while enumeration only over coefficients in [-2,2] cannot certify unrestricted CVP soundness. Exact seed kernels tensor forward, and no evidence establishes multiplicativity against entangled integer vectors.

Kill Proposal 6 as a general route. Classical Nullstellensatz degree lower bounds imply that fixed degree leaves normalized dual pseudo-functionals on some unsatisfiable formulas, whereas degree growing linearly makes the full Macaulay monomial set exponential; the proposed repetition does not escape this size barrier.
